description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_getscript' that generates a script tag for a specified filename with caching considerations. It includes license information and a function that retrieves a versioned script path based on input parameters.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getscript
methods.description: Generates a script tag for a specified filename, appending a version cache string. Triggers an error via Smarty if the 'file' parameter is missing.
